exposure: type of anesthesia: general anesthesia vs. spinal anesthesia
cohort: 186 patients undergoing elective cesarean section, 99 with general anesthesia and 87 with spinal anesthesia.
finding: While there was no significant difference in neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio or most leukocyte elements between general and spinal anesthesia after cesarean section, eosinophil count and eosinophil-lymphocyte ratio were significantly different between the two groups.
